description: InfraNamedWindowViews ext-time-slice: the ext_timed(value, 10 sec) sliding window, its projection variant with a separately deployed consumer and the epoch-referenced ext_timed_batch window, all driven purely by event timestamps with the clock pinned at the epoch (Java source regression-lib/src/main/java/com/espertech/esper/regressionlib/suite/infra/namedwindow/InfraNamedWindowViews.java).

cases.description: ext_timed(value, 10 sec) window over the key/value map schema: the sliding threshold newest-9999 releases expired rows as old data together with the arriving row in one invocation, and a delete releases old-only rows
cases.createEpl: @name('create') create window MyWindowETW#ext_timed(value, 10 sec) as MySimpleKeyValueMap
cases.insertEpl: insert into MyWindowETW select theString as key, longBoxed as value from SupportBean
cases.s0Epl: @name('s0') select irstream key, value as value from MyWindowETW
cases.deleteEpl: @name('delete') on SupportMarketDataBean delete from MyWindowETW where symbol = key

cases.description: legacy win:ext_timed(value, 10 sec) projection window over theString/longBoxed with four module deployments and only the window statement listened across the expiry, delete and reinsert waves
cases.createEpl: @name('create') @public create window MyWindow.win:ext_timed(value, 10 sec) as select theString as key, longBoxed as value from SupportBean
cases.insertEpl: insert into MyWindow(key, value) select irstream theString, longBoxed from SupportBean
cases.consumeEpl: @name('consume') select irstream key, value as value from MyWindow
cases.deleteEpl: @name('delete') on SupportMarketDataBean as s0 delete from MyWindow as s1 where s0.symbol = s1.key

cases.description: epoch-referenced ext_timed_batch(value, 10 sec, 0L) window over the key/value map schema: arrivals stay silent until the 10 second boundary, the flush releases the batch as new data with the replaced batch as old data, and deletes never touch the pending batch
cases.createEpl: @name('create') create window MyWindowETB#ext_timed_batch(value, 10 sec, 0L) as MySimpleKeyValueMap
cases.insertEpl: insert into MyWindowETB select theString as key, longBoxed as value from SupportBean
cases.s0Epl: @name('s0') select irstream key, value as value from MyWindowETB
cases.deleteEpl: @name('delete') on SupportMarketDataBean as s0 delete from MyWindowETB as s1 where s0.symbol = s1.key
